title: Microsoft, Meta, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Palantir have a message for Washington
byline: Brent D. Griffiths, Kelsey Vlamis, Lakshmi Varanasi
excerpt: For his first-ever post on X, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang shared an open letter to DC calling for the protection of open source AI.

In his first-ever post on X, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang called attention to how some of the biggest names in AI and tech are rallying together to defend the future of open-weight AI models.

"AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country," Huang wrote on X. "Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty."

On Friday, Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI, Mistral, and others signed an open letter that urges US policymakers not to crack down on open-weight AI models.

For my first post, I’m sharing a letter @NVIDIA signed on why open models matter.

AI will transform every industry, power every company, and be built by every country.

Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation and diffusion, and enable sovereignty.… pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C

— Jensen Huang (@JensenHuang) July 24, 2026

Their statement amounts to a full-throated endorsement of open-weight AI models at a time when top Trump administration officials have suggested they might take action against Moonshot AI, the creator of the Kimi K3, the world's most powerful open-weight AI model.

"Our AI leadership will be judged not by one frontier AI model, but by whether the United States builds a strong, open ecosystem that diffuses into every sector," the signatories wrote in the letter.

When the letter was initially published, the two biggest absences were OpenAI and Anthropic, widely viewed as the world leaders in the frontier AI model race. However, by Friday evening, OpenAI also signed on, adding its name to the list of signatories published by Microsoft.

Unlike Anthropic's Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Sol, Kimi K3, as an open-source model, will soon be available for download and customization. Both companies would stand to gain if the US government either directly blocks or significantly impedes China-based open model makers like Moonshot AI.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said earlier on Friday he was "glad to see" the support for open weight models.

"i want the US to win in AI both in open source and proprietary models," Altman wrote on X. Under his post, a community note, which was still present after OpenAI was added to the signatories list, claimed OpenAI had "refused" to sign the letter.

While SpaceXAI is not listed as a signatory, Elon Musk later signaled his support for the message. "This has my full support," Musk wrote on X, quoting Huang's tweet. "Jensen is right."

Google also has not yet officially signed the letter. Google CEO Sundar Pichai, however, showed his support on Saturday. He agreed with Huang in a post on X. "Very happy to support this on behalf of Google," he wrote.

That leaves Anthropic as the only major AI company yet to support open-source models.

While the letter does not mention Moonshot specifically, its authors portray the broader development of open AI models as akin to how open software revolutionized computing in the 1980s.

"Open source did more than lower the cost of software; it created a shared foundation of knowledge on which generations of American engineers and entrepreneurs built their institutional sovereignty," they wrote.

China has thus far dominated the development of open-weight AI models, despite the US' legendary reputation in the creation of open-source software. Two of the biggest modern names in open software, Mozilla and the Linux Foundation, also signed onto the letter.

In the US, Nvidia's Nemotron model is one of the largest open weight models, though its performance pales in comparison to rivals like Kimi K3. Alexandr Wang, chief AI officer of Meta, has said that his Meta Superintelligence Labs team remains committed to open models and is developing an open variant of its Muse Spark model. Reflection AI, a startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers, is also preparing its own open model.

On Wednesday, Michael Kratsios, director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, publicly accused Moonshot of developing Kimi K3 by distilling the model from Anthropic's Fable 5. Distillation, the process of training a weaker model on the outputs of a stronger one, is a controversial yet widely used practice in AI development. At the same time, companies like Anthropic have accused their Chinese counterparts of abusing the distillation process to the point of essentially ripping off their intellectual property.

Earlier this week, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested that the US could sanction companies that engage in such distillation, which he compared to theft.

The letter defends the distillation process more broadly, but it does open the door to the possibility that companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Meta would support a crackdown on those proven to be bad actors.

"Unlawful efforts to extract value from closed models raise legitimate concerns," they wrote. "Those concerns should be addressed through targeted legal and commercial frameworks rather than sweeping restrictions on techniques that play an important role in AI innovation."

In total, a combination of 32 companies, organizations, and platforms signed on to the letter as of Friday evening. They are the American Innovators Network, Andreessen Horowitz, Arcee AI, Arena, Black Forest Labs, Box, Cisco, Cohere, CrowdStrike, Dell Technologies, DoorDash, Emergence Capital, Fireworks AI, GitHub, Hugging Face, IBM, The Linux Foundation, Mariana Minerals, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, Mozilla, Nvidia, OpenAI, Palantir, Palo Alto Networks, Perplexity, Reflection, Replit, ServiceNow, Telnyx, and Y Combinator.

sentences.zh: “很高兴代表谷歌支持这一点，”他写道。

blocks.html_en: That leaves Anthropic as the only major AI company yet to support open-source models.

sentences.en: That leaves Anthropic as the only major AI company yet to support open-source models.
sentences.zh: 这使得 Anthropic 成为唯一一家尚未支持开源模型的大型人工智能公司。

blocks.html_en: While the letter does not mention Moonshot specifically, its authors portray the broader development of open AI models as akin to how open software revolutionized computing in the 1980s.

sentences.en: While the letter does not mention Moonshot specifically, its authors portray the broader development of open AI models as akin to how open software revolutionized computing in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 虽然这封信没有具体提及 Moonshot，但其作者将开放人工智能模型的更广泛发展描述为类似于 20 世纪 80 年代开放软件如何彻底改变计算。

blocks.html_en: "Open source did more than lower the cost of software; it created a shared foundation of knowledge on which generations of American engineers and entrepreneurs built their institutional sovereignty," they wrote.

sentences.en: "Open source did more than lower the cost of software; it created a shared foundation of knowledge on which generations of American engineers and entrepreneurs built their institutional sovereignty," they wrote.
sentences.zh: 他们写道：“开源不仅仅降低了软件成本；它创造了一个共享的知识基础，几代美国工程师和企业家在此基础上建立了他们的机构主权。”

blocks.html_en: China has thus far dominated the development of open-weight AI models, despite the US' legendary reputation in the creation of open-source software. Two of the biggest modern names in open software, Mozilla and the Linux Foundation, also signed onto the letter.

sentences.en: China has thus far dominated the development of open-weight AI models, despite the US' legendary reputation in the creation of open-source software.
sentences.zh: 尽管美国在创建开源软件方面享有传奇般的声誉，但迄今为止，中国仍主导着开放权重人工智能模型的开发。

sentences.en: Two of the biggest modern names in open software, Mozilla and the Linux Foundation, also signed onto the letter.
sentences.zh: 现代开放软件领域的两大巨头 Mozilla 和 Linux 基金会也在这封信上签名。

blocks.html_en: In the US, Nvidia's Nemotron model is one of the largest open weight models, though its performance pales in comparison to rivals like Kimi K3. Alexandr Wang, chief AI officer of Meta, has said that his Meta Superintelligence Labs team remains committed to open models and is developing an open variant of its Muse Spark model. Reflection AI, a startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers, is also preparing its own open model.

sentences.en: In the US, Nvidia's Nemotron model is one of the largest open weight models, though its performance pales in comparison to rivals like Kimi K3.
sentences.zh: 在美国，Nvidia 的 Nemotron 模型是最大的开放重量模型之一，尽管其性能与 Kimi K3 等竞争对手相比相形见绌。

sentences.en: Alexandr Wang, chief AI officer of Meta, has said that his Meta Superintelligence Labs team remains committed to open models and is developing an open variant of its Muse Spark model.
sentences.zh: Meta 首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 表示，他的 Meta Superintelligence Labs 团队仍然致力于开放模型，并正在开发其 Muse Spark 模型的开放变体。

sentences.en: Reflection AI, a startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers, is also preparing its own open model.
sentences.zh: 由前谷歌 DeepMind 研究人员创立的初创公司 Reflection AI 也在准备自己的开放模型。

blocks.html_en: On Wednesday, Michael Kratsios, director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, publicly accused Moonshot of developing Kimi K3 by distilling the model from Anthropic's Fable 5. Distillation, the process of training a weaker model on the outputs of a stronger one, is a controversial yet widely used practice in AI development. At the same time, companies like Anthropic have accused their Chinese counterparts of abusing the distillation process to the point of essentially ripping off their intellectual property.

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Michael Kratsios, director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, publicly accused Moonshot of developing Kimi K3 by distilling the model from Anthropic's Fable 5.
sentences.zh: 周三，白宫科技政策办公室主任 Michael Kratsios 公开指责 Moonshot 通过提炼 Anthropic 的《神鬼寓言 5》中的模型来开发 Kimi K3。

sentences.en: Distillation, the process of training a weaker model on the outputs of a stronger one, is a controversial yet widely used practice in AI development.
sentences.zh: 蒸馏是根据较强模型的输出来训练较弱模型的过程，是人工智能开发中一种有争议但广泛使用的做法。

sentences.en: At the same time, companies like Anthropic have accused their Chinese counterparts of abusing the distillation process to the point of essentially ripping off their intellectual property.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，像 Anthropic 这样的公司指责中国同行滥用蒸馏工艺，以至于实质上窃取了他们的知识产权。

blocks.html_en: Earlier this week, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested that the US could sanction companies that engage in such distillation, which he compared to theft.

sentences.en: Earlier this week, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suggested that the US could sanction companies that engage in such distillation, which he compared to theft.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，财政部长斯科特·贝森特建议美国可以制裁从事此类蒸馏活动的公司，他将这种蒸馏活动比作盗窃。

blocks.html_en: The letter defends the distillation process more broadly, but it does open the door to the possibility that companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Meta would support a crackdown on those proven to be bad actors.

sentences.en: The letter defends the distillation process more broadly, but it does open the door to the possibility that companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Meta would support a crackdown on those proven to be bad actors.
sentences.zh: 这封信更广泛地为蒸馏过程辩护，但它确实为英伟达、微软和 Meta 等公司支持打击那些被证明是不良行为者的可能性打开了大门。

blocks.html_en: "Unlawful efforts to extract value from closed models raise legitimate concerns," they wrote. "Those concerns should be addressed through targeted legal and commercial frameworks rather than sweeping restrictions on techniques that play an important role in AI innovation."

sentences.en: "Unlawful efforts to extract value from closed models raise legitimate concerns," they wrote.
sentences.zh: 他们写道：“从封闭模型中获取价值的非法行为引起了合理的担忧。”

sentences.en: "Those concerns should be addressed through targeted legal and commercial frameworks rather than sweeping restrictions on techniques that play an important role in AI innovation."
sentences.zh: “这些担忧应该通过有针对性的法律和商业框架来解决，而不是对在人工智能创新中发挥重要作用的技术进行全面限制。”

布伦特·D. Griffiths 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 , Kelsey Vlamis 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。和 Lakshmi Varanasi 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 在 X 上发表的第一篇文章中，呼吁人们关注人工智能和科技领域的一些知名人士如何联合起来捍卫开放权重人工智能模型的未来。

黄在X上写道：“人工智能将改变每个行业，为每个公司提供动力，由每个国家建设。” “开放模式加强安全和网络安全，加速创新和扩散，并实现主权。”

周五，英伟达、微软、Meta、OpenAI、Mistral 等公司签署了一封公开信，敦促美国政策制定者不要打击开放权重人工智能模型。

在我的第一篇文章中，我将分享@NVIDIA 签署的一封信，解释为什么开放模型很重要。人工智能将改变每个行业，为每个公司提供动力，并由每个国家构建。开放模型加强安全和网络安全，加速创新和传播，并实现主权。... pic.twitter.com/t02bi51N4C—黄仁勋 (@JensenHuang) 2026 年 7 月 24 日

在特朗普政府高级官员表示他们可能对 Moonshot AI 采取行动之际，他们的声明相当于对开放权重人工智能模型的全力支持。Moonshot AI 是世界上最强大的开放权重人工智能模型 Kimi K3 的创造者。

签署者在信中写道：“判断我们的人工智能领导力的标准不是一个前沿人工智能模型，而是美国是否建立了一个强大、开放的生态系统，并扩散到各个领域。”

当这封信最初发表时，两个最大的缺席者是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic，它们被广泛视为前沿人工智能模型竞赛的世界领导者。 然而，到了周五晚上，OpenAI 也签署了协议，将其名字添加到了微软公布的签署者名单中。

与Anthropic的Fable 5和OpenAI的GPT-5.6-Sol不同，Kimi K3作为开源模型，很快就会提供下载和定制。 如果美国政府直接阻止或严重阻碍 Moonshot AI 等中国开放模型制造商，两家公司都将受益。

OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 周五早些时候表示，他“很高兴看到”对开放权重模型的支持。

Altman 在 X 上写道：“我希望美国在人工智能领域赢得开源和专有模型的胜利。” 在他的帖子下，有一份社区说明（在 OpenAI 被添加到签署者名单后仍然存在），声称 OpenAI“拒绝”签署这封信。

虽然 SpaceXAI 并未被列为签署者，但埃隆·马斯克后来表示支持该消息。 “这得到了我的全力支持，”马斯克在 X 上写道，引用了黄的推文。 “詹森是对的。”

谷歌还没有正式签署这封信。 然而，谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)周六表示了支持。 他在 X 上的一篇帖子中同意黄的观点。 “很高兴代表谷歌支持这一点，”他写道。

这使得 Anthropic 成为唯一一家尚未支持开源模型的大型人工智能公司。

虽然这封信没有具体提及 Moonshot，但其作者将开放人工智能模型的更广泛发展描述为类似于 20 世纪 80 年代开放软件如何彻底改变计算。

他们写道：“开源不仅仅降低了软件成本；它创造了一个共享的知识基础，几代美国工程师和企业家在此基础上建立了他们的机构主权。”

尽管美国在创建开源软件方面享有传奇般的声誉，但迄今为止，中国仍主导着开放权重人工智能模型的开发。 现代开放软件领域的两大巨头 Mozilla 和 Linux 基金会也在这封信上签名。

在美国，Nvidia 的 Nemotron 模型是最大的开放重量模型之一，尽管其性能与 Kimi K3 等竞争对手相比相形见绌。 Meta 首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 表示，他的 Meta Superintelligence Labs 团队仍然致力于开放模型，并正在开发其 Muse Spark 模型的开放变体。 由前谷歌 DeepMind 研究人员创立的初创公司 Reflection AI 也在准备自己的开放模型。

周三，白宫科技政策办公室主任 Michael Kratsios 公开指责 Moonshot 通过提炼 Anthropic 的《神鬼寓言 5》中的模型来开发 Kimi K3。 蒸馏是根据较强模型的输出来训练较弱模型的过程，是人工智能开发中一种有争议但广泛使用的做法。 与此同时，像 Anthropic 这样的公司指责中国同行滥用蒸馏工艺，以至于实质上窃取了他们的知识产权。

本周早些时候，财政部长斯科特·贝森特建议美国可以制裁从事此类蒸馏活动的公司，他将这种蒸馏活动比作盗窃。

这封信更广泛地为蒸馏过程辩护，但它确实为英伟达、微软和 Meta 等公司支持打击那些被证明是不良行为者的可能性打开了大门。

他们写道：“从封闭模型中获取价值的非法行为引起了合理的担忧。” “这些担忧应该通过有针对性的法律和商业框架来解决，而不是对在人工智能创新中发挥重要作用的技术进行全面限制。”

截至周五晚上，共有 32 家公司、组织和平台签署了这封信。 他们是美国创新者网络、Andreessen Horowitz、Arcee AI、Arena、Black Forest Labs、Box、思科、Cohere、CrowdStrike、戴尔技术、DoorDash、Emergence Capital、Fireworks AI、GitHub、Hugging Face、IBM、Linux 基金会、Mariana Minerals、Meta、微软、Mistral、Mozilla、Nvidia、OpenAI、Palantir、Palo Alto Networks、Perplexity、Reflection、Replit、 ServiceNow、Telnyx 和 Y Combinator。
